import numpy as np

# Fiscal years 2010-2024 (in millions of dollars)
# Source: Treasury/OMB historical federal receipts and outlays
years = list(range(2010, 2025))

receipts = {
    2010: 2162706,
    2011: 2303466,
    2012: 2449988,
    2013: 2775103,
    2014: 3021487,
    2015: 3249886,
    2016: 3267961,
    2017: 3316182,
    2018: 3329904,
    2019: 3463364,
    2020: 3421164,
    2021: 4047111,
    2022: 4896119,
    2023: 4439303,
    2024: 4918734,  # ~$4.92 trillion per excerpt
}

outlays = {
    2010: 3457079,
    2011: 3603059,
    2012: 3536945,
    2013: 3454647,
    2014: 3506284,
    2015: 3691850,
    2016: 3852615,
    2017: 3981634,
    2018: 4109042,
    2019: 4446953,
    2020: 6553616,
    2021: 6822449,
    2022: 6271507,
    2023: 6134089,  # FY2023 outlays
    2024: 6751543,  # ~$6.75 trillion per excerpt
}

R = np.array([receipts[y] for y in years], dtype=float)
O = np.array([outlays[y] for y in years], dtype=float)

def hp_filter(y, lam):
    n = len(y)
    I = np.eye(n)
    # second difference matrix D (n-2 x n)
    D = np.zeros((n-2, n))
    for i in range(n-2):
        D[i, i] = 1.0
        D[i, i+1] = -2.0
        D[i, i+2] = 1.0
    A = I + lam * D.T @ D
    trend = np.linalg.solve(A, y)
    return trend

lam = 100
trend_R = hp_filter(R, lam)
trend_O = hp_filter(O, lam)

# FY2024 is last index
idx = years.index(2024)
actual_balance = R[idx] - O[idx]
structural_balance = trend_R[idx] - trend_O[idx]
gap = abs(actual_balance - structural_balance)

a = round(actual_balance)
s = round(structural_balance)
g = round(gap)

print(f"[{a}, {s}, {g}]")
